purpose: Test whether descriptive population characteristics, covariate distributions, association estimates, and prediction-model performance are reproducible between PCORnet and the frozen lineage-faithful OMOP representation, separating fixed-cohort representation effects from end-to-end cohort-selection effects.

index_cohort.definition: Locked Stage C D0 ischemic-stroke cohort
index_cohort.primary_fixed_population: Patients shared by source and lineage-faithful OMOP D0 with identical index dates and 90-day observability in both representations.
index_cohort.secondary_end_to_end_population: Representation-specific source D0 and lineage-faithful OMOP D0 patients with 90-day observability in that representation.

outcome.name: 90-day acute-care reutilization
outcome.definition: Same locked Stage D primary binary outcome: any ED, EI, or IP encounter/visit beginning after index discharge through day 90 inclusive.
outcome.observability: Continuous source ENROLLMENT or target observation_period through day 90, as appropriate to the representation.

features.feature_rule: Construct each feature independently from native PCORnet and lineage-faithful/native OMOP tables using matched conceptual definitions. Do not use target lineage to force feature equality in the primary representation-level feature comparison, except for cohort linkage and the lineage-faithful index definition inherited from Stage D.
features.missingness: Report missingness by feature and representation. Continuous model features use training-set median imputation; binary features use training-set mode imputation. Missingness indicators are not added in v1.
features.scaling: For logistic models, continuous predictors are standardized using training-set mean and standard deviation within each representation.

prediction_models.name: logistic_regression
prediction_models.implementation: scikit-learn LogisticRegression with effectively unpenalized or very weak L2 regularization if solver requires a finite penalty

prediction_models.name: ridge_logistic_regression
prediction_models.implementation: scikit-learn LogisticRegression with L2 penalty and C=1.0

prediction_models.name: hist_gradient_boosting
prediction_models.implementation: scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier with fixed random_state and otherwise documented defaults

prediction_evaluation.split: Deterministic 70/30 patient-level train/test split based on a stable SHA-256 hash of the source patient identifier. The hash is used transiently and patient identifiers are not written to aggregate outputs.
prediction_evaluation.fixed_cohort_rule: Use the same hashed patient split in PCORnet and OMOP for shared fixed-index patients.
prediction_evaluation.end_to_end_rule: Apply the same hash rule independently to representation-specific cohorts.

comparison_hierarchy.primary: Fixed-cohort representation-level reproducibility: same patients, index dates, and outcome observability; features are constructed independently in each CDM.
comparison_hierarchy.secondary: End-to-end reproducibility: independently selected source and OMOP cohorts, allowing cohort attrition and feature availability to affect results.

interpretation_guardrails: Model-performance similarity does not prove feature-level semantic equivalence.
Model-performance difference does not by itself identify an ETL defect.
Fixed-cohort differences primarily assess representation/feature construction effects; end-to-end differences combine cohort selection and representation effects.
Stage E is an extension beyond the analytically closed Stages A-D and must be reported as such.
No prediction-model tuning may use cross-CDM agreement as an optimization target.
